description.en: Agent CLIs on this Mac, cmux servers and the team VM: versions, updates, installs and sign-ins, run by cmux in a terminal you can see.
description.ja: このMac、cmuxサーバー、チームVMのエージェントCLI。バージョン、アップデート、インストール、サインインを、cmuxが見えるターミナルで実行します。

scopes.machine:read: List this Mac, your cmux servers and the team VM.
scopes.agent_cli:read: See which agent CLIs are installed, their versions and sign-in state. Never a credential or an email.

optionalScopes.agent_cli:execute: Run a CLI's own update, install or sign-in command in a terminal you can see, only when you tap.
optionalScopes.actions:run: Open the cmux Accounts sign-in on this Mac.

title.ja: エージェントCLIのデザイン

showMissing.title: Show agent CLIs that are not installed
